translations.web: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him, and forgave him the debt.
translations.bsb: His master had compassion on him, forgave his debt, and released him.
translations.kjv: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt.
